abilities.name: Nox Nostra
abilities.text: Active: Unleash a cloud of bats that seek out targets, each dealing spirit damage and applying Silence. Passive: Triggering Love Bites against heroes permanently increases the number of bats released.

tiers.text: On Hit: Deal +0.5% Current Health as Damage

abilities.name: Rend
abilities.text: Swipe at enemies in a cone ahead of you, dealing spirit damage. If the enemy is in close range, deal bonus melee damage.

tiers.text: Deals 55% Heavy Melee Damage Silences enemies for 2s if close range

abilities.name: Stalker's Mark
abilities.text: Send out a mark that bleeds the first target it hits, dealing spirit damage over time. While the enemy is bleeding you can re-activate Stalker's Mark to instantly appear behind their back.

tiers.text: +3m/s Move Speed when around an isolated enemy hero
On isolated hero death: Heal 24% of your missing health and restores 2 Stamina

abilities.name: Eternal Night
abilities.text: Surround nearby enemy heroes in darkness, severely limiting their vision of other units. Affected enemies are briefly revealed to you and are considered isolated for the duration. You gain bonus sprint speed.

abilities.name: Consecrating Grenade
abilities.text: Fire a grenade that bounces before exploding, dealing weapon damage and setting enemies on fire. Burning targets deal pure damage to enemies in the area and suffer from reduced healing.

abilities.name: Gutshot
abilities.text: Fire a blast with your shotgun, dealing weapon damage and pushing enemies back. Enemies near a wall receive stun and take bonus weapon damage.

tiers.text: On Wall Stun: Your next heavy melee is blessed

abilities.name: Hex-Lined Snap Trap
abilities.text: Kick a trap that arms after a brief delay. The trap springs on the first enemy it touches, dealing spirit damage, applying immobilize, and revealing enemies for a duration afterwards.

tiers.text: +1 Charge Deal +30% damage against revealed targets

abilities.name: Ira Domini
abilities.text: Load your crossbow with 3 stakes, dealing massively increased weapon damage. The final stake is blessed, dealing bonus pure damage and executing low-health enemies.

tiers.text: While Active: Gain 1.2 m/s Move Speed

abilities.name: Pain Battery
abilities.text: Taking any damage passively charges up your Pain Battery. Once full, activating the ability fires multiple shocking bolts, dealing spirit damage once per target.

tiers.text: On Hero Hit: Heal for 15% of your missing health and increased Spirit scaling

abilities.name: Jumpstart
abilities.text: Deal spirit damage to yourself. Then, gain bonus regeneration and bonus move speed, decaying over time.

tiers.text: +1 Charge +50% Debuff Resistance Increases spirit scaling

abilities.name: Aura of Suffering
abilities.text: Unleash pain, dealing spirit damage over time to both enemies and yourself. The damage continues to increase the longer the ability is channeled, up to a maximum amount.

tiers.text: Enemies receive 20% Move and Dash Slow

abilities.name: Shocking Reanimation
abilities.text: Release a wave after taking lethal damage, applying a diminishing slow. After a brief channel you reanimate, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to nearby enemies.

tiers.text: While On Cooldown: Gain +15% Fire Rate and 6.0 Spirit Damage per Bullet

abilities.name: Bookwyrm
abilities.text: Conjure a dragon that appears at the target location before flying forward, dealing spirit damage and leaving a burning path in its trail.

abilities.name: Plot Armor
abilities.text: Grant an ally a barrier. While the barrier holds, they gain bonus weapon damage.

tiers.text: Affects up to 2 additional allies. Increases barrier scaling.

abilities.name: Captivating Read
abilities.text: Target an area with latent magic, applying slow. The magic detonates after a delay, dealing spirit damage and applying immobilize.

tiers.text: +2m Radius On Hit: Reduce Spirit Resist by -18% for 6s

abilities.name: Rallying Charge
abilities.text: Release a wave of spectral knights and steeds that charge across the entire city, healing allies and dealing spirit damage to enemies. The strength of the heal and spirit damage is amplified as the knights travel further.

abilities.name: Call Bell
abilities.text: Throw out a call bell that deals spirit damage on impact. After a short delay it explodes, dealing additional spirit damage and causing affected enemies to suffer reduced weapon accuracy and movement slow. Can be shot to detonate early.

abilities.name: Doorway
abilities.text: Place two connected doors in the world. Players and most projectiles entering one door will exit out through the other. The doors will close at the end of the duration. The two doors must be placed within the doorway distance of each other.

tiers.text: Grants a Barrier first time traveling through doors
+30m Cast Range. +40m Doorway Distance and scales with Spirit Power.

abilities.name: Luggage Cart
abilities.text: Send out a Luggage Cart that deals spirit damage and pulls enemy heroes along its path. Can be alt cast with to target friendly heroes instead.

tiers.text: +25m Cast Range +75 Damage on wall impact
-15s Cooldown and 1.25s stun on wall impact

abilities.name: Hotel Guest
abilities.text: Send the target's physical body to be a guest at the Baroness Hotel. The guest is to promptly make their way to the exit elevator, where they'll be sent back to their original position. A stay at the Baroness Hotel is paid for in spirit damage. Failure to check-out on time costs additional spirit damage.

tiers.text: +150 Damage +1.5s Stun on Failure to Check Out
Unstoppable while the Baroness is occupied. 15s Cooldown on Failure to Check Out.

abilities.name: Lifethread
abilities.text: Fire a line that attaches to the world, allowing you to swing. Lifethread resets all air jumps and air dashes.

abilities.name: Flakshot
abilities.text: Bullets deal bonus weapon damage and can ricochet off of surfaces.

abilities.name: Demontrigger Blitz
abilities.text: Load your weapon with demonic rounds. After a delay, release a blitz of bullets at the target enemy, dealing bonus Damage. Enemies can intercept the bullets.

abilities.name: Jeté
abilities.text: Leap in a target direction. If no direction is chosen, then leap straight up instead.

abilities.name: Acrobat
abilities.text: Gain stacking bonuses every time you dash, double jump, wall jump, or teleport. Gaining new stacks refreshes the duration.

abilities.name: Bashdown
abilities.text: Slam your bat into the ground, pulling enemies down and dealing melee damage. The slam creates a shockwave that deals spirit damage and applies knockup.

tiers.text: -3.0s Charge Time Now deals 50% Heavy Melee Damage

abilities.name: Rising Ram
abilities.text: Charge head-first into an enemy and send them into the air along with Billy. Cooldown reduced by 50% on impact.

abilities.name: Blasted
abilities.text: Passive: Melee hits restore ammo and inflict wrecked on the victim for 7.0s.

tiers.text: +1 Bashdown Charge on use and +7% Wrecked Bullet Amp
+50 Melee Bonus Health and increases spirit scaling

abilities.name: Chain Gang
abilities.text: Chain nearby enemies to you. Chained enemies cannot use movement abilities and receive a heavy slow when they pull on the chain. After a delay, yank everyone towards Billy and deal spirit damage. The chain breaks if you lose line of sight for a short while.

tiers.text: +5m Range +1.3s of Unstoppable Per Hero pulled in

abilities.name: Jar of Dead
abilities.text: Passive: Collect death when anything dies nearby and store it in your Jar of Dead. Active: Throw a jar to summon Deadheads that repeatedly deal spirit damage to enemies. Deadheads follow you instead if there's no nearby enemies, and prioritize the target of your weapon.

tiers.text: Collecting death heals 5 health per pickup

abilities.name: Grasping Hands
abilities.text: Unearth a line of grasping hands, summoning a Ghoul and leaving behind a rift. Enemies who pass through take spirit damage and receive immobilize. Alt-Cast rotates the orientation of the wall.

abilities.name: Essence Theft
abilities.text: Your weapon steals weapon damage and spirit resist over time, up to a maximum amount per target.

tiers.text: +1 Max Steal Targets All Summons now apply Essence Theft
On Death: Deal +5% Current Health as Damage

abilities.name: Disengaging Sigil
abilities.text: Draw a sigil sphere in front of you and then leap backwards as it explodes, damaging and slowing enemies caught in it.

tiers.text: Gain +25% Fire Rate and +25% Bullet Speed for 8s
On Player Hit: +1 stamina restored and resets Air Jump/Dash limit

abilities.name: Riposte
abilities.text: Prepare to deflect the next incoming attack. On a successful deflection, briefly become invulnerable and target an enemy hero to dash towards them, stunning them and reducing their Melee Resist. Press Ability 2 to select a target. Does not trigger against trooper or neutral damage.

tiers.text: Gain 75% Bullet, Spirit & Melee Lifesteal against the Riposte target for 13s

abilities.name: Flawless Advance
abilities.text: Perform a series of lunges in any direction, delivering piercing stabs ahead of you. Hold your ability key to time your attacks, dealing more damage the longer it's held. Releasing your attack during the perfect window deals maximum damage. Press Ability 3 to re-cast.

tiers.text: -12s Cooldown. Gain +60% Bullet Resist during lunge
+65 Perfect Damage with improved Spirit scaling. Increased lunge speed & distance.

abilities.name: Itani Lo Sahn
abilities.text: Charge up and perform a long range slash. Struck enemies cannot take action or heal and are stuck in slow motion. When this effect expires, they suffer devastating damage, dealing bonus damage against half-health enemies. While in slow motion, Apollo is invulnerable and enemies take reduced damage. Hold Ability 4 or to delay the cast.

abilities.name: Pillow Toss
abilities.text: Throw your trusty pillow inflicting spirit damage and heavy knockback. Landing hits reduces the cooldown of your other abilities.

abilities.name: Tag Along
abilities.text: Jump to an ally and nap alongside them. Both you and the ally receive a burst heal based on missing health followed by lingering regeneration. Hop between allies with Ability 2 to apply the heal, once per ally. You are knocked off if stunned by an ultimate ability. You can use items and all self-casts target your ally instead.

tiers.text: 35% Bonus Item Range, Duration, and Barrier Effectiveness while napping
+15% Spirit Power and +35 Spirit Power while napping and for 10s after napping Improved Spirit Scaling

abilities.name: Lil Helpers
abilities.text: Signal a Helper to lend a hand. They can collect boxes, do Sinner's Sacrifices, or be sent to support allies and troopers. Follow a hero: Provides a short burst of spirit resist and fading move speed. Follow a trooper: Provides healing, damage, resists, and allows tagging along. When no hero is around, souls from trooper kills are split amongst the team. Can be cast during Tag Along. Helpers will take a nap for 15.1s after following someone.

abilities.name: Naptime
abilities.text: Cast your gaze forward, piercing walls and floors. Enemies in the gaze are slowed, have reduced dash distance, and cannot use movement abilities. When the channel ends they fall asleep before waking up to a splitting headache that deals heavy spirit damage.

tiers.text: -1 Stamina On Wake and no Stamina Regen while sleeping
-55s cooldown Reduced damage and unstoppable while channeling

abilities.name: Slam Fire
abilities.text: Instantly reload your gun. You gain bonus fire rate and deal bonus weapon damage based on the target's health for a limited number of shots, but suffer from reduced accuracy. Deals bonus Weapon Damage against troopers and neutrals.

tiers.text: If you hit all shots, deal +7% current health as damage
+80 Bonus Damage and kicked enemies deal -35% Damage for 5s

abilities.name: Entangling Bola
abilities.text: Throw a bola, dealing spirit damage, applying slow and preventing movement abilities or stamina.

tiers.text: +0.75s Debuff Duration. Bola ricochets to 2 additional targets

abilities.name: Lycan Curse
abilities.text: Passive: Dealing damage generates bloodlust, increased at low health. At max bloodlust, you automatically cast Lycan Curse. Active: Instantly transform, gaining increased max health, and stacking fire rate on enemy heroes, and replacing your abilities and weapon with their ferocious versions.

tiers.text: +4 m/s Move Speed and 200 Bonus Health
On Hero Kill: Refresh abilities and duration

abilities.name: Light Eater
abilities.text: Blast enemies in a cone in front of you with a flare of light. Blasted enemies take spirit damage when attacked by Celeste and provides her spirit lifesteal.

abilities.name: Dazzling Trick
abilities.text: Surround yourself in a protective prism. If the barrier is destroyed, it silences nearby enemies and deals a portion of the barrier as damage.

tiers.text: +70 Barrier and Increased Barrier Spirit Scaling
+1.25 Silence Duration and -20s Cooldown. Allows Shining Wonder Bounce.

abilities.name: Radiant Daggers
abilities.text: Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short duration, the beam will fully form, causing an explosion that deals spirit damage to all targets in the area. Celeste will receive a stacking buff that increases her spirit damage anytime this hits an enemy hero.

abilities.name: Shining Wonder
abilities.text: Launch a deadly orb of light that deals spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact. The orb then bounces to the enemies within range. If no target is found, the orb will linger for a short duration while continuing to look for targets. Prioritizes enemy heroes when picking targets.

abilities.name: Scrap Grenade
abilities.text: Throw a grenade of scrap that detonates multiple times, dealing bullet damage and applying slow. The grenade can be meleed to knock it away.

tiers.text: Add an additional final Bigger Detonation

abilities.name: Rat Swarm
abilities.text: Call forth a swarm of rats that leap onto enemies, dealing spirit damage over time and reducing their bullet resist with every bite. The more rats are attached, the faster they will bite the target. Enemies can have multiple rats attached, but can shake off a rat early by performing a ground or air dash.

tiers.text: +8 Damage and -1% Bullet Resist per Bite

abilities.name: Royal Pestments
abilities.text: Adorn scrappy armor, gaining barrier based on your max health. As long as the armor holds, bullets have a chance to be deflected back towards the attacker. The barrier does not benefit from resists.

tiers.text: Reduce all damage to a max of 250 +10% Max Health as Barrier

abilities.name: Rule, Ratannia!
abilities.text: Charge up and summon the banner of Ratannia, granting all nearby allies increased move speed, immunity from slows, and reduced incoming damage while near the banner.

abilities.name: Threadsap
abilities.text: Weave a scraggly thread that follows your crosshair before bursting along its path, dealing spirit damage and stealing enemy Spirit, increased in effectiveness for Baba. While holding stolen Spirit, Baba deals bonus spirit damage with every bullet.

abilities.name: Granny Long Legs
abilities.text: Your bench's legs extend, granting bonus move speed, higher jumps, Debuff Resistance and Melee Resistance. Light Melee: Perform a kick that knocks enemies back. Heavy Melee: Perform a ground pound that applies knockup, slow, and deals spirit damage. Hold Crouch / slide to charge a high jump, release to jump.

abilities.name: Baba's Brew
abilities.text: Brew a pot of tea that applies a magical effect in an area when thrown, cycling over time between a soothing barrier, Silence, or scalding burn that deals spirit damage over time and reduces spirit resist. Press to pause or resume brewing.

abilities.name: Feed The Birds
abilities.text: Cover targets in front of you with bread, adding a stacking slow . When the channel ends a flock of pigeons bombard the targets, dealing spirit damage and hexing each target into a pigeon, increasing in both damage and duration based on bread count.

tiers.text: +125 Max Damage +125 Spirit Scaling +0.5s Max Duration

items.name: Echo Shard
items.text: Reset the cooldown of the imbued non-ultimate ability. This item's cooldown is increased by the cooldown of the imbued ability.

items.name: Refresher
items.text: Reset the cooldown of all your abilities and restore all your charges.

items.name: Witchmail
items.text: Taking heavy hits of spirit damage from an enemy reduces a random ability cooldown.

items.name: Spirit Strike
items.text: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, deal extra spirit damage with the attack and reduce the target's Spirit Resist. Cooldown is 2x longer for Light Melee hits.

items.name: Active Reload
items.text: While reloading, pressing Reload during the highlighted portion will instantly finish your reload and grant you Fire Rate, Bullet Lifesteal and Move Speed.

items.name: Vortex Web
items.text: Throw a vacuum grenade, pulling all enemies into a small area and applying Slowing Hex. Alt Cast to Target Unit Directly.

items.name: Armor Piercer
items.text: Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance.

items.name: Duration Extender
items.text: Imbue an ability to increase its Duration.

items.name: Arcane Surge
items.text: After you Dash-Jump, the next ability you use within 7s will have bonus Range, Duration, and Spirit Power.

items.name: Arctic Blast
items.text: Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage, Freezing and then Slowing targets it hits. Slowed targets have their stamina regen frozen

items.name: Indomitable
items.text: The next Stun, Chain, Immobilize, Sleep or Silence is automatically cleansed. When this happens, you gain a barrier and all your ability cooldowns get reduced by 20%.

items.name: Crippling Headshot
items.text: Landing a Headshot will reduce their Bullet, Spirit Resist, and Incoming Healing.

items.name: Berserker
items.text: Your Weapon Damage increases as you take sustained damage.

items.name: Blood Tribute
items.text: Toggle: Continually sacrifice Health to improve fire rate, Debuff Resistance and Move Speed.

items.name: Lifestrike
items.text: Your Melee Attack applies Movement Slow and heals you for a percentage of the Melee Damage dealt plus a fixed amount. This heal is 40% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

items.name: Hunter's Aura
items.text: Reduces nearby enemies' Bullet Resist and Fire Rate. If there is only one enemy hero nearby, this effect is doubled.

items.name: Bullet Resist Shredder
items.text: Reduces Bullet Resist on enemies when you deal spirit damage.

items.name: Ballistic Enchantment
items.text: Imbue an ability with increased range. Dealing damage with that ability grants you increased weapon damage per unique hero hit. Has reduced effect on non-heroes.

items.name: Burst Fire
items.text: Briefly gain Fire Rate and Move Speed when one of your bullets hits an enemy hero.

items.name: Capacitor
items.text: Launch a projectile that deals damage, applies a strong slow that recovers over time, prevents Stamina usage and Silences their movement-based items and abilities. Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

items.name: Enduring Speed
items.text: Reduces the effect of enemy Move Speed penalties.

items.name: Celestial Blessing
items.text: Applies an extremely powerful cleanse that replenishes your allies globally.

items.name: Tesla Bullets
items.text: Your bullets have a chance to shock your target. The shock will jump to a nearby enemy.

items.name: Cheat Death
items.text: When you would take lethal damage, instead become temporarily death immune and remove all non-stun debuffs. While death immune, you deal reduced damage and have reduced healing.

items.name: Fortitude
items.text: After not taking damage for a period, gain health regen. When you are above 75% health, you have bonus Move Speed.

items.name: Cloak of Opportunity
items.text: Block the next debuff that would apply movement lock, Stun, Chained, Immobilize, or Sleep and become Unstoppable. Also gain a Barrier and bonus move speed

items.name: Shadow Weave
items.text: Become Stealthed. Whenever you take damage while Stealthed you get briefly revealed. Attacking or using an ability will end your stealth and start an ambush, temporarily granting you bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Melee Damage.

items.name: Point Blank
items.text: When in close range to your target, gain Weapon Damage and your bullets apply a Movement Slow.

items.name: Close Quarters
items.text: Deal additional Weapon Damage when in close range to your target.

items.name: Cold Front
items.text: Release an expanding ice blast that deals spirit damage and Slows targets it hits.

items.name: Colossus
items.text: Grow larger in size, gaining bullet resist, spirit resist, and melee damage. Nearby enemies suffer from slow and have reduced dash speed.

items.name: Slowing Hex
items.text: Slows movement of enemy target. Also Silences their movement-based items and abilities. Increases the target's gravity. Does not affect target's stamina usage.

items.name: Superior Cooldown
items.text: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities.

items.name: Counterspell
items.text: Your next parry protects you from the damage and effects of enemy abilities and items. On a successful spell parry heal and gain move speed and Spirit.

items.name: Mystic Shot
items.text: Your next bullet deals bonus spirit damage.

items.name: Lucky Shot
items.text: Your bullets have a chance to be empowered, causing them to deal bonus weapon damage on hit. Bonus damage cannot Crit.

items.name: Crushing Fists
items.text: Your melee damage will restore ammo and apply a stacking bullet resist debuff on enemies. Heavy melee applies 2 stacks. If the target reaches max stacks, they will be stunned. Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage.

items.name: Leech
items.text: Reduces the effect of enemy applied healing reduction.

items.name: Debuff Reducer
items.text: Reduces the duration of all negative effects applied to you.

items.name: Plated Armor
items.text: Gain a chance to either deflect incoming bullets, preventing all weapon damage or prevent all on-hit effects from bullets.

items.name: Scourge
items.text: Apply Spirit Resist, Debuff Resist and an aura on a friendly target that deals damage to enemies proportional to their max health. Existing debuffs on the target are reduced. Can be self cast.

items.name: Divine Barrier
items.text: Remove all non-stun debuffs from the target and provide them with a Barrier and Move Speed. Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

items.name: Diviner's Kevlar
items.text: Upon casting an ultimate ability gain a Barrier and temporary Spirit Power.

items.name: Heroic Aura
items.text: Provides Bullet Resist to nearby friendly units. Provides move speed and fire rate to you and nearby allies. Minions get double value.

items.name: Haunting Shot
items.text: Your next bullet applies a powerful debuff reducing the enemy's damage output, healing and movement speed. It also deals bonus spirit damage based on the target's current Health. The bullet is larger and penetrates through targets.

items.name: Electric Slippers
items.text: When sliding, evade bullets, gain fire rate and deal damage to enemies around you. Cooldown is per target.

items.name: Spellslinger
items.text: While in-combat whenever you cast an ability or item, gain a stacking buff that improves fire rate and reload speed. Each stack refreshes the duration.

items.name: Escalating Exposure
items.text: Dealing spirit damage applies a stacking Spirit Amp that increases your spirit damage to the target.

items.name: Eternal Gift
items.text: Periodically gain a random permanent stat buff. Reduces your next death's respawn timer.

items.name: Mercurial Magnum
items.text: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use. Until your next reload, your bullets deal bonus spirit damage based on your Spirit Power.

items.name: Express Shot
items.text: Your next attack will fire twice in quick succession with increased damage and velocity. This attack consumes extra ammo.

BonusSpiritForChargedAbilities.label: Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities

items.name: Frenzy
items.text: While you are below 50% health, you gain stat bonuses for a duration and existing debuffs on you are reduced.

items.name: Fleetfoot
items.text: Removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting. Gain bonus Move Speed and Slow Resistance.

items.name: Focus Lens
items.text: Target an enemy to Silence them. A portion of all damage dealt during the silence gets applied to the target when the silence wears off.

items.name: Fury Trance
items.text: Grants Fire Rate, Spirit Resistance and Move Speed, and removes the Move Speed penalty while shooting, but Silences you and disables stamina usage and regeneration.

items.name: Glass Cannon
items.text: Each hero kill grants permanent Fire Rate (up to a max of 8 times). Death results in the loss of 1 stack.

items.name: Cursed Relic
items.text: Curses an enemy - interrupting, Silencing, Disarming, and preventing item usage. Removes all non-ultimate buffs. Your own Damage Output is reduced for the duration.

items.name: Golden Goose Egg
items.text: Gain souls over time, as long as you are alive. Hatch the egg, gaining souls and permanent buffs. The value of the egg grows the longer you hold onto it. Gain a permanent buff per 80 Souls accrued when hatched.

items.name: Disarming Hex
items.text: Disarms enemy target and reduces their Bullet Resist.

items.name: Grit
items.text: Gain a Barrier for a short duration.

items.name: Guardian Ward
items.text: Provide the target with a Barrier and temporary Move Speed. Can be self-cast. Cooldown is reduced by half when cast on someone else.

items.name: Headhunter
items.text: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage, heal you, and briefly grants bonus move speed.

items.name: Headshot Booster
items.text: Your next headshot against an enemy Hero deals bonus weapon damage.

items.name: Weakening Headshot
items.text: Landing a Headshot reduces their Bullet Resist.

items.name: Healbane
items.text: Your spirit damage reduces the enemy's Incoming Healing. If an enemy hero dies under this effect, you receive a large heal.

items.name: Healing Tempo
items.text: Applying heal to yourself or an ally grants the target bonus fire rate and bonus move speed. Does not apply on innate Regen or passive Bullet/Spirit Lifesteals.

items.name: Healing Booster
items.text: Increases the effectiveness of your healing.

items.name: Healing Nova
items.text: Heal yourself and nearby allies.

items.name: Healing Rite
items.text: Grant Regen and Sprint Speed to the target. Gets dispelled if you take damage from enemy players or objectives. Can be self-cast.

items.name: Hollow Point
items.text: When you are above 65% health, deal additional Weapon Damage and your bullets reduce enemy Bullet Resist.

items.name: Seraphim Wings
items.text: When Airborne, You deal more damage and take reduced damage. Allows unlimited Air Dash and Jumping.

items.name: Superior Duration
items.text: Increases the duration of your abilities and items.

items.name: Bullet Resilience
items.text: When below 50% health, gain additional Bullet Resist.

items.name: Infinite Rounds
items.text: You have infinite ammo. Your Bullets have a chance to become unavoidable, piercing through enemies and ignoring their Bullet Resistance.

items.name: Infuser
items.text: Gain Spirit Lifesteal and Spirit Power.

items.name: Inhibitor
items.text: Your bullets build up to reduce the target's outgoing damage and apply healing reduction.

items.name: Intensifying Magazine
items.text: Increases Weapon Damage as you continuously fire your weapon.

items.name: Juggernaut
items.text: Enemies that shoot you have their Fire Rate slowed.

items.name: Kinetic Dash
items.text: When you Dash-Jump you gain Fire Rate and bonus Ammo until your next reload. Lasts up to 7s.

items.name: Melee Lifesteal
items.text: Your next Melee attack heals you. This heal is 30% effective vs non-heroes. Cooldown is 1.5x as long for Light Melee hits.

items.name: Long Range
items.text: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

items.name: Mystic Burst
items.text: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, causing abilities dealing more than 80 damage to deal additional damage.

items.name: Magic Carpet
items.text: Summon a Magic Carpet that will fly you away. While flying you are immune to slows and doing any action will dismiss the carpet. Cannot use abilities while the carpet is being summoned.

items.name: Mystic Expansion
items.text: Imbue an ability to increase its range and effect radius.

items.name: Enchanter's Emblem
items.text: While you are above 65% health, gain bonus Spirit and Cooldown Reduction.

items.name: Tankbuster
items.text: Charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, causing abilities dealing more than 165 damage to deal additional damage. Ignores Spirit Resistance.

items.name: Mystic Slow
items.text: When the target takes spirit damage, they have their Move Speed reduced.

items.name: Surge of Power
items.text: Imbue an ability with permanent Spirit Power. When that ability is used, gain bonus Move Speed and maintain full speed while attacking.

items.name: Compress Cooldown
items.text: Imbue an ability to reduce its Cooldown.

items.name: Mystic Vulnerability
items.text: When an enemy takes spirit damage, they have their spirit resist reduced.

items.name: Restorative Shot
items.text: Your next bullet will heal you based on what target you hit.

items.name: Melee Charge
items.text: Your next Heavy Melee attack against an enemy deals increased damage.

items.name: Rebuttal
items.text: On a successful Parry against an enemy Hero, Heal yourself for the damage parried and returns that damage to the target, and temporarily gain increased damage.

items.name: Metal Skin
items.text: Become immune to bullets.

items.name: Mystic Regeneration
items.text: Dealing spirit damage to enemy Heroes grants you Bonus regeneration. Stacks when dealing damage to different heroes.

items.name: Mystic Reverb
items.text: Imbue an ability with Lifesteal and to apply slow on a hit target and deal an additional percentage of the damage dealt to enemies around the target after a short delay.

items.name: Mystical Piano
items.text: After a short delay, enemies in the target area will be stunned and have their stamina depleted. After the stun they will be temporarily dazed.

items.name: Cultist Sacrifice
items.text: Target an enemy NPC and consume it for 170% Bonus Souls and grants a powerful long lasting buff.

items.name: Nullification Burst
items.text: Removes any positive buffs and prevents stamina usage and healing effects on enemies.

items.name: Omnicharge Signet

BonusSpiritForChargedAbilities.label: Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities

items.text: Imbue any active non-ultimate ability with Bonus Ability Charges. Already charged abilities receive more bonus charges.

items.name: Mystic Conduit
items.text: Provides yourself and allies with a powerful spirit focused aura. Has reduced values on allies. Dealing significant Damage to an enemy Hero within 5s causes you to heal yourself and nearby allies.

items.name: Phantom Strike
items.text: Teleport to an enemy target and pull them to the ground. Dealing damage, Move speed reduction and Disarm.

items.name: Prism Blast
items.text: You enter a void state and become untargetable and invincible for a short duration, during which lasers blast out and rotate around you.

items.name: Opening Rounds
items.text: Your attacks have additional Weapon Damage against enemies above 50% health.

items.name: Silencer
items.text: Your bullets build up to a Silence. Victims are immune to the build up for 10s after silence expires. Your bullets reduce the target's outgoing spirit damage.

items.name: Quicksilver Reload
items.text: Your imbued ability charges up over time with bonus spirit damage, bonus fire rate, and reloads bullets on use.

BonusSpiritForChargedAbilities.label: Bonus Spirit Power for Charged Abilities

items.name: Recharging Rush
items.text: Dealing significant weapon damage replenishes a charge for each of your charged abilities.

items.name: Dispel Magic
items.text: Purge all non-ultimate negative effects currently applied to you. If any effects were removed, heal yourself and gain a move speed bonus. Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.

items.name: Battle Vest
items.text: While you are above 65% health, gain weapon damage and bonus fire rate.

items.name: Escalating Resilience
items.text: Grants Bullet Resist when your bullets hit an enemy hero. Each shot can only grant one stack.

items.name: Rescue Beam
items.text: Heals a target allied hero and yourself for a percentage of Max Health. Once while healing, you can Pull the target towards you. Can be self-cast.

items.name: Radiant Regeneration
items.text: Heal and gain bonus Movement Speed for a short duration when you cast an ability. Dealing spirit damage to enemy Heroes grants you Bonus regeneration. Stacks when dealing damage to different heroes.

items.name: Restorative Locket
items.text: When an enemy uses an ability within 32mm range from you, store one Restoration Stack. Consume all stacks to heal yourself and replenish up to 3 stamina based on how many stacks you have.

items.name: Return Fire
items.text: Automatically fire a bullet towards any attacker who damages you with their abilities or weapon.

items.name: Ricochet
items.text: Your bullets will ricochet on enemies near your target, applying any bullet procs and dealing a percentage of the original damage.

items.name: Majestic Leap
items.text: Launch yourself high into the air and grant yourself a Barrier. While in the air, you can use the active again to drop down faster. Cannot be used for 5s if attacked by enemy Hero.

items.name: Runed Gauntlets
items.text: Every time you land a heavy melee, your existing cooldowns get reduced. Pierces through parry.

items.name: Decay
items.text: Inflict damage over time to a target, dealing damage based on their current health. Decay's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.

items.name: Ethereal Shift
items.text: Instantly enter a void state and become Invulnerable for a short duration. Afterwards, gain a variety of temporary buffs:

items.name: Shadow Strike
items.text: Go Invisible on Stamina use with no detection range. Doing a melee attack while invisible will cause you to steal bullet and spirit resistance from them and deal damage over time.

items.name: Sharpshooter
items.text: Deal additional Weapon Damage when beyond a minimum distance from your target.

items.name: Frostbite Charm
items.text: Imbued ability has its Cooldown reduced and gains Spirit Power. When the ability deals damage, freeze the target and apply bonus damage. Cooldown is per target.

items.name: Shrink Ray
items.text: Reduces Model Size and grants Move Speed to the target. Allows usage of tunnels in this mode. Can be self-cast.

items.name: Siphon Bullets
items.text: Your bullets temporarily steal Max HP from enemies. Enemies regain their stolen health when the debuff expires.

items.name: Slowing Bullets
items.text: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

items.name: Spellbreaker
items.text: The next instance of high spirit damage you take is significantly reduced.

items.name: Spirit Rend
items.text: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them. Landing headshots against the target reduces their Spirit Resist further.

items.name: Spirit Shielding
items.text: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant spirit damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

items.name: Spirit Burn
items.text: Dealing significant spirit damage to an enemy within 5s causes an explosion dealing damage and a burn to that enemy. While burning, enemies take damage over time and receive reduced healing. The cooldown is per enemy, so each target can only be burned once per cooldown. Deals half-damage on non-heroes.

items.name: Spirit Sap
items.text: Target an enemy to reduce their Spirit Resist and Spirit Power.

items.name: Spirit Snatch
items.text: When you perform a Light or Heavy Melee attack against a hero, the attack deals extra spirit damage and steals Spirit Resist and Spirit Power. Effects are reduced by 30% for Light Melee hits.

items.name: Split Shot
items.text: Make your weapon fire multishot. Hitting more than one Hero per attack will grant a stacking weapon damage bonus. Targets can only be hit once per multishot.

items.name: Stamina Mastery
items.text: Allows an additional use of Air Jump or Air Dash before landing.

items.name: Suppressor
items.text: When you deal spirit damage to enemies, you also reduce their Fire Rate.

items.name: Vampiric Burst
items.text: Grants Lifesteal, Fire Rate, and Ammo. This added Ammo is not limited by your max magazine size.

items.name: Knockdown
items.text: Apply a Stun after 2s. Stun duration is increased against airborne targets. Increases the target's gravity for the duration of the stun.

items.name: Silence Wave
items.text: Launch an expanding projectile which Silences enemies for a short duration and deals impact damage. Silence does not interrupt channeling abilities.

items.name: Torment Pulse
items.text: Periodically deals spirit damage to the closest two enemies nearby.

items.name: Spirit Shredder
items.text: Your bullets apply a debuff that reduces the Spirit Resist of the target and grants you and your allies Spirit Lifesteal against them.

items.name: Spiritual Overflow
items.text: Gain bonus Fire Rate, Spirit Power and Spirit Lifesteal by charging up when shooting enemy heroes.

items.name: Spirit Resilience
items.text: When below 50% health, gain additional Spirit Resist.

items.name: Greater Expansion
items.text: Increases the range and effect radius of your abilities and items.

items.name: Alchemical Fire
items.text: Throw a flask that explodes on contact, creating an area that does increasing spirit damage per second and reduces enemy Bullet Resist. 50% less effective vs non-heroes.

items.name: Toxic Bullets
items.text: Your bullets build up a Bleed on enemies, causing them to lose a percentage of their Max Health over time. Also reduces Incoming Healing on the bleeding target.

items.name: Transcendent Cooldown
items.text: Reduces the Cooldown of your abilities and items.

items.name: Trophy Collector
items.text: Whenever you score an assist or kill, gain extra sprint, ability range and passive soul generation. This effect stacks and persists through death.

items.name: Lightning Scroll
items.text: Damage from your ultimate applies a stun and deals bonus spirit damage after a short delay. This effect can only trigger once per target per ultimate. Mystic Slow effects

items.name: Unstable Concoction
items.text: Consume a concoction that grants you Unstoppable and increased speed, health, spirit and weapon damage. After a short duration you die and explode, stunning nearby enemies and dealing damage based on your maximum health. Dying this way reduces your respawn time by 50%.

items.name: Unstoppable
items.text: Temporarily suppress negative status effects and become immune to Stun, Silence, Sleep, Root, and Disarm. Cannot be used while Stunned or Slept.

items.name: Veil Walker
items.text: Walking through a cosmic veil grants you Stealth, Heal and increased Move Speed.

items.name: Reactive Barrier
items.text: Gain a Barrier when you are Stunned, Chained, Immobilized, Slept or Silenced.

items.name: Warp Stone
items.text: Teleport straight ahead, gaining Bullet Resist.

items.name: Stalker
items.text: Dealing weapon damage at close range opens a wound and grants you bonus move speed. Wounded enemies take spirit damage over time, have reduced bullet resist, and are revealed through walls.

items.name: Weapon Shielding
items.text: Gain a Barrier whenever you take significant weapon damage from enemy Heroes in a small time frame.

items.name: Weighted Shots
items.text: Your bullets build up a Movement Slow on enemies.

items.name: Rusted Barrel
items.text: Target an enemy to reduce their Fire Rate and Bullet Resistance.

provenance.interpretation: Unlock currency type 2, point currency type 1. Modal point delta per tier across 291 builds (agreement 100%+). Cross-check: level schedule grants 32 points and 4 unlocks.
